correctness.rationale: The top stratum is the connected unordered configuration manifold of dimension nk; the lower-cardinality stratum has dimension at most n(k−1), at least two below. Relative top homology therefore identifies the top group with the Borel–Moore top group of the top stratum. A regular target configuration has preimages formed by independent choices in its k fibers, yielding the mod-two product formula. In even oriented dimension, permutation of blocks preserves orientation and the signed count factors to (deg f)^k.

value.rationale: This is a reusable coefficient-sensitive structural law for a functor used in configuration-space topology. It distinguishes the even-dimensional oriented degree power from the orientation-free mod-two behavior and identifies the odd-dimensional integral obstruction, while explaining why the circle case must be excluded. The result provides an immediate top-degree invariant for induced maps without claiming lower-homology or homotopy-type information.
